title: UFOs over nuclear ICBMs as a message, not over data centers

tellings.quote: with nuclear ICBMs and so on so forth you know we can see them over the nuclear uh ICBMs and so that might be a message

related.note: Same subject, UFOs over nuclear ICBMs, but the core claim is that they are sending a message, unlike the waiting-for-humanity explanation.

plain: UFOs are seen over nuclear missile sites, and that, a researcher on the show suggests, might be a message, while they are not seen over data centres. The guest, who is not named, says it as a reading of the pattern rather than as something they saw, in an episode about whether AI is alien technology.
